summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: Package impersonates the legitimate @verdaccio/local-storage plugin (description text points at the real verdaccio monorepo; repository is set to an unrelated servicetitan/uikit repo). On `npm install`, the `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts and chmods it executable, and then uses that fetched runtime to `execFileSync` a shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (hex-named identifiers, shuffled string-array with a rotator function `WV8StW` and const array `n7gIxM=[...]`) whose name is unrelated to the package's advertised verdaccio storage purpose. Downloading a separate JS runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated blob under a benign-plugin cover story is the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the obfuscated payload executes on every default install before any consumer code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
